title: Hop and Spin
sentences: Brad and Fran had a drum in class with Miss Roz.
Miss Roz said, “A clap is for a hop.”
She said, “A drum tap is for a spin.”
Miss Roz gave the drum one tap.
Fran gave the drum one tap.

comprehensionQuestion.question: Why did Miss Roz do a spin?
answers: Brad gave a bell one tap.
Fran gave the drum one tap.
Brad gave a box one tap.
